description: Returns a published government fee and its effective date. For US (the default), the general filing fee for a USCIS form and filing method; category-specific US fees are unavailable, so omit category. US covers I-90, I-130, I-140, I-485, I-539, I-765, and N-400, paper and online; any other form returns not_found. For GB, the fee for a published Home Office fee category; pass the section heading as category when the name appears in more than one section. amount_cents is in the minor unit of currency. filing is "unspecified" when the source states no filing channel. It does not say which fee applies to a case. For a USCIS form's current edition, use check_form_edition. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Sources: for US, the USCIS fee schedule (Form G-1055) and the 2024 USCIS fee rule (89 FR 6194); for GB, the Home Office visa regulations revised table on gov.uk, used under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

category.description: For US, unsupported by the current dataset and returns not_found. For GB, the published section heading. Required when the fee category name appears in more than one section.

filing.description: How the form is filed: "paper" (mailed) or "online" (USCIS online account). Required for US. Ignored for GB.

form.description: For US, the USCIS form number exactly as USCIS writes it, e.g. "I-765"; "i765" and "I765" do not match. For GB, the published Home Office fee category name.

name: get_fee

amount_cents.description: Fee in the minor unit of currency; 47000 with USD is $470.00.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for amount_cents, e.g. "USD" or "GBP".

effective_date.description: Date this fee took effect, YYYY-MM-DD
